provided.name: RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant
provided.transaction: preview and hard-delete classify are read-only; hard-delete classify accepts stable snapshot or current writer read context and uses one exact Communication dependency predicate. Terminal revalidate uses caller LLD-03 writer UnitOfWork, recomputes the complete current Communication impact authority using the preview algorithm, exact-compares reviewed count/fingerprint, returns no impact rows and mutates nothing. Apply uses that same caller UnitOfWork only after both provider revalidations READY, deliberate proof consumption and outer receipt insertion; it records exact Communication consequence/history/audit rows under command_context.command_id, never opens a receipt/commit, and returns one bounded RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1 whose fingerprint binds the complete provider-owned result/audit identities without exporting that unbounded set.

rules: Communication evidence and proposals never mutate owner-domain lifecycle by themselves.
All apply/disposition participants reuse the owning caller UnitOfWork and never create a nested receipt or commit.

RFC terminal-cascade Communication impact revalidation is a complete-set current-authority check inside the caller LLD-03 writer UnitOfWork and must succeed before proof consumption or Communication apply.
RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionCommandContextV1 is provenance only and contains no proof/session secret; Communication business/history authority remains LLD-09.
There is no terminal-cascade consequence-count business maximum. Exact Communication rows remain row-wise LLD-09 authority and only the bounded apply summary crosses back to LLD-03.
RFC hard-delete dependency classification is read-only and uses one exact predicate for stable preview snapshots and current writer read contexts.
Deep Scan deliberate proof is single-use and consumed through LLD-12; Communications stores no proof/session secret.
